correctness.rationale: For all integers q,n>=2, distinct length-(n-2) outputs are indexed by unique earliest greedy embeddings. Let S be the number of adjacent symbol changes, J the count of consecutive pairs of changes, e the sum of endpoint-change indicators, and T the count of pairwise distinct triples. The source derives B=1+binom(S,2)+2(S-J)-e+T. Conditional on the change bits the rainbow events are independent with q-2 vs 1 choices, yielding the binary-change generating polynomial and its equivalent run-composition sum. The orthogonal Bernoulli expansion gives its exact nonbinary variance. I independently compared BOTH assigned formulas with direct descendant sets in 21 exhaustive (q,n) cases and symbolically proved their variance polynomials coincide for all formal p,n. These finite tests corroborate, not replace, the greedy embedding and conditional-choices proof; n=2 yields B=1.
